title: Clinical Triage Assistant for Radiology Departments
business: Radiology departments in regional hospitals facing high volumes of routine imaging requests.
problem: Radiologists experience significant burnout due to the high volume of routine chest X-rays requiring preliminary review before formal reporting.
solution: Implementing MedGemma-4b-it as a multimodal triage assistant to provide preliminary descriptive analysis of chest X-rays, allowing radiologists to prioritize urgent cases.
steps: Provision a GPU-enabled environment with sufficient VRAM for the 4B parameter model.
Configure the Transformers pipeline using the image-text-to-text task type.
Define a system prompt establishing the model as an expert radiologist to guide the output tone and focus.
Pass the incoming X-ray image and the clinical query through the model's chat template.
Review the generated text output for clinical relevance before incorporating it into the radiologist's workflow.
outcome: Improved radiologist efficiency by surfacing high-priority findings and reducing the time spent on initial descriptive documentation.
limitation: The model requires clinical validation for all outputs; users must verify generated descriptions against actual image data to ensure accuracy before final clinical decision-making.

code.content:
# Initialize the pipeline for multimodal medical analysis
from transformers import pipeline
pipe = pipeline("image-text-to-text", model="google/medgemma-4b-it", device="cuda")

# Define the clinical role and the specific task
messages = [
    {"role": "system", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "You are an expert radiologist."}]},
    {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Describe this X-ray"}, {"type": "image", "image": image}]}
]

# Generate the preliminary description
output = pipe(text=messages, max_new_tokens=200)
